items.title: Ernest "Kid" Milton Interview, 1961-04-26
items.q: Interviewer states: 'That's Caffrey's cousin.' Interviewee does not claim a personal relationship with Caffrey, only that the interviewer identifies a connection.

ctx.x: He played. And we had a band together, me and Willie Darren Boyd. We worked at Millen Boyd together.

Lil' Deden Boyd's a violin player, he lived in Batten World. Oh, the Davenport? Darren's Boyd. Darren's Boyd. Oh, Darren's Boyd. That's Caffrey's cousin. Oh, sure, sure. The great band, I'll play Caffrey's cousin. Sure.
Um, did you have a name on that first band? Any just your band? Or did you have any...
